reason: Both memos satisfy the heading, five-bullet, and final-sentence requirements and both give an honest treatment of the strongest counterargument, but neither meets the 250-350 word cap: Response A runs to about 374 words (well over) while Response B runs to about 358 (much closer to compliant). Response B is also tighter, avoiding some of Response A's redundant explanatory clauses, and its pilot framing ties the objection response back to the proposal more concretely.
